PRIVACY

A clear approach to your information.

This website provides company information and helps you prepare a WhatsApp enquiry.

Enquiry details

Form entries are processed in your browser to prepare a message. This site does not send those entries to a server or store them in a database. When you choose to continue to WhatsApp, the message text is passed to that service. You decide whether to send it.

Third-party services

WhatsApp operates under its own terms and privacy policy. Site hosting may process technical request information needed to serve the website. No advertising pixels or third-party analytics scripts have been added to this build.

Files and sensitive information

Only share information needed for the initial project discussion. Agree a suitable channel with Gravita before sharing confidential technical or commercial files.

Questions

Contact Gravita at +91 96266 54485 regarding information you choose to share with the business.
